statement: Phase 2 of solve-v2 (schema and CLI cutover), Solver tooling (workflow) scope: the v2 schema, a lossless migration that converts every quest, log and epic to v2 with a mapping report whose counts sum to every entry and whose unmapped table is empty, and the four-command CLI (start refuses a green probe; note; probe; land honors the last verdict, requires a verification entry for src changes, runs the change proof and the coupled-pair guard) replace scripts/solve and test/solve in one cutover; solve/ ends under 20 MB with every quest directory on shape.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Every v1 log entry is copied verbatim; the mapping report sums to every entry with zero unmapped rows; anything not expressible keeps its bytes under quest.json.legacy with a decision finding.
solve/ under 20 MB on disk, no file over 1 MB, every quest directory on shape, scripts/solve.js + scripts/solve/ at most 6000 lines and test/solve/ at most 6000; npm run check green at every commit.
land keeps calling npm test (select-change-tests.js) and the coupledPairs landing guard; test selection, impact contracts and the proof cone are not reimplemented.
